findings.title: Validate the flusher process count as a positive integer
findings.body: `--flusher-processes` accepts zero and negative values. Zero is silently converted to the number of assigned shards by `max_processes or len(...)`, violating the documented maximum, while a negative value reaches `range(self.num_processes)` with a negative count and then raises `KeyError` when shard assignment indexes a nonexistent process entry. A bad deployment/config value can therefore either unexpectedly spawn one worker per shard or prevent the span consumer from starting. Use a Click integer range with a minimum of 1 (and defensively validate the constructor argument).

findings.title: The new flusher-process test never exercises multiprocessing
findings.body: Supplying `produce_to_pipe=messages.append` intentionally makes `SpanFlusher` create `threading.Thread` workers rather than spawned processes. This test only verifies the in-memory shard-to-worker mapping; it cannot catch failures in the production path such as spawning, pickling `SpansBuffer`/synchronization values, Sentry initialization, or process lifecycle behavior. Add an integration-style test that uses the normal producer setup (mocking Kafka as needed) and verifies multiple spawned workers can flush assigned shards.
